method: Compose compatible branch-family contracts, establish a failing baseline, repair general contracts, mutate the evaluator, and rerun the full deterministic bank without weakening assertions.

iterations.new_pressure: Relation holds, holdout independence, human provenance, exact config and feedback identity, typed eval oracles, publication clearance, and complete idempotence receipts
failures: Related clear siblings could escape a protected duplicate or burst.
A final evaluation could pass without identified-human decision provenance.
Changed feedback could be reused after evaluation.
Release plans did not bind config, feedback, or the publication boundary.
Typed eval-bank, holdout, publication, and execution validators were absent.

changes: Config and feedback digests across evaluation, validation, and release
Typed eval bank, holdout audit, publication register, and execution attempt validators

iterations.new_pressure: Evaluator mutations plus clean positive controls
changes: Bank fails when its PROCEED control, holdout dimension, or counterfactual is removed.
Independent holdout passes without exposing identifiers.
Publication remains default closed but accepts complete identified-human evidence.
Two distinct complete bound attempts pass idempotence while duplicate or incomplete attempts fail.
iterations.stop_reason: The evaluator mutations and positive controls passed, then an implementation reread exposed one more attempt-comparison weakness.

iterations.new_pressure: Same-title, same-count production plans with different image membership
changes: Snapshot plans carry a content SHA-256 echoed by the helper receipt.
Each attempt validates the exact plan digest before receipt comparison.
Idempotence compares exact authorized memberships, not only album titles and counts.
iterations.stop_reason: Exact same-count membership substitution failed after the repair; one final representation audit remained.

iterations.new_pressure: Empty holdout and malformed structured eval fields
changes: An empty holdout cannot claim independence.
Unsafe shortcuts and assertions must be nonempty structured lists, not caution-sounding strings.
The full macOS check also covers 24 unit tests and Swift typechecking.
iterations.stop_reason: All 31 executable cases and 13 typed semantic cases pass; evaluator mutations fail as intended; same-count membership substitution and empty holdout fail; the 4,000-item case remains fast; the synthetic demo and Swift contract pass separately.
